name: console table
caption: A console table with a narrow top, a lower shelf and four slim legs. A framed top joins four legs; a straight apron links the legs. Flat tabletop panels keep a constant thickness with squared legs. Overall width is 2.40 times depth; height is 0.75 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous oak brown, white, charcoal color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
